edits.why: The mount journal greys out every mount and refuses drags below this level, whatever the character can ride. The server lets everyone ride from level 1 (T-011).

edits.name: Call of Xuen
edits.description: Xuen's Gift. Call the spirit of Xuen, the White Tiger, to fight at your side, its claws crackling with lightning. Your critical strikes build Thunder, which keeps the tiger with you longer and brings the Gift back sooner.
edits.why: Heartseed Gift button (T-086): its own name, tooltip and icon instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger (monk talent). Cooldown as heartseed_gift sets it on the server, so the tooltip matches.

edits.name: Crane's Plume
edits.description: Chi-Ji's Gift. The Red Crane's hope heals you and the most wounded members of your group. Healing you do or receive builds Hope, which makes the next Plume stronger.
edits.why: Heartseed Gift button (T-086): its own name, tooltip and icon instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Spirit of Chi-Ji (legendary cloak proc); cannot crit, as the core makes the source. Cooldown as heartseed_gift sets it on the server, so the tooltip matches.

edits.name: Niuzao's Retort
edits.description: Niuzao's Gift. After a heavy blow, answer with the Black Ox's charge, striking the enemies before you for a share of the damage you just took. Usable only for a few seconds after the blow.
edits.why: Heartseed Gift button (T-086): its own name, tooltip and icon instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Ox Charge (creature spell). Cooldown as heartseed_gift sets it on the server, so the tooltip matches.
Serpent's Breath visual (T-086): a kit for the breath while the aura lasts, copied from Cleansing Breath's (jade dragon breath), with the directed channel animation.

Serpent's Breath visual (T-086): its own copy of the jade dragon breath model so it can be sized apart from Cleansing Breath. Its flame travels about 30 model units; 0.5 carries it about 15 yards, past the breath's measured reach (.areaprobe: hits to 12.5-14.5 yards from a target's edge). Tune here.
Serpent's Breath visual (T-086): the jade dragon breath model on the caster's breath point, so it comes from the mouth and scales with the caster's model.
Serpent's Breath visual (T-086): Celestial Breath's visual played the breath only when the aura ended; this one loops the jade breath while it lasts.

edits.name: Serpent's Breath
edits.description: Yu'lon's Gift. Breathe jade fire in a cone, burning every enemy before you. Your spell casts build Coil, which makes the next Breath stronger.
edits.why: Heartseed Gift button (T-086): its own name, tooltip and icon instead of the borrowed spell's. Clone of Celestial Breath (creature spell); ticks start after the first period, as the core makes the source. Cooldown as heartseed_gift sets it on the server, so the tooltip matches.
